output.reason: [ev-19231a7aa629] says that in 2.3 and earlier, users with `applications, get` automatically had logs access. From 3.0 the flag is removed and logs RBAC is enforced by default, so the `logs` tab on the pod view "will not be visible without granting explicit `logs, get` permissions". This sits under Breaking Changes, and the detection section says affected users "should perform the below remediation steps". Users losing access they relied on is permission-lost, not a behavior-change that keeps working.

correction.statement: From Argo CD 3.0, server.rbac.log.enforce.enable is removed and logs RBAC is always enforced. Users, groups and roles without explicit `logs, get` permission lose the pod-view logs tab they previously had through `applications, get`.

consequence.statement: Users/groups/roles that relied on implicit logs access via `applications, get` lose it: the `logs` tab on the pod view is not visible without explicit `logs, get` permission.
consequence.remediation: Grant explicit `logs, get` permissions to the users/groups/roles that need log access. After the upgrade, remove server.rbac.log.enforce.enable from the argocd-cm ConfigMap if it was set.
